CustomField.description: This field builds the conditional Generated Document File Name for Sales
CustomField.formula:
IF( TEXT(NSP_PrimaryProduct__c) == 'WO' && NOT(ISBLANK(Account.NSP_AIMS_Client__c)),
NSP_Account_Name__c + "_" + TEXT(NSP_Merge_On_Demand_Template_Selection__c) + "_" + Account.NSP_AIMS_Client__c + "_" ,
NSP_Account_Name__c + "_" + TEXT(NSP_Merge_On_Demand_Template_Selection__c) + "_" )
CustomField.label: Sales Template Document Name
